caption.default: Great job, we are getting closer!
caption.hint: a short line under the track; "" leaves it empty

value.hint: the number as said; it must be in the transcript; value (with commas and decimals) + suffix is at most 10 characters

max.hint: the track is full at this number and fills to value/max; use the total the speaker gives, or 100 for a percent

dark.hint: true = light text for dark footage; false = the block's dark-on-light scheme

dy.hint: moves the card up (negative) or down, in pixels; set automatically to keep it off your face
